task.title: Creating a repository by using the UI
task.shortdesc: To create an image repository in Quay, you can use the UI. You select a namespace and set a repository name and visibility.

context.p: Use the following procedure to create a repository using the Quay UI.

step.cmd: Click Repositories on the navigation pane.
Select a namespace, for example, quayadmin, and then enter a Repository name, for example, testrepo.

note.p: Do not use the following words in your repository name: * build * trigger * tag * notification

When these words are used for repository names, users are unable access the repository, and are unable to permanently delete the repository. Attempting to delete these repositories returns the following error: Failed to delete repository <repository_name>, HTTP404 - Not Found.

info.p: Now, your example repository should populate under the Repositories page.

step.cmd: Optional. Click Settings → Repository visibility → Make private to set the repository to private.
